facts.text: We dug a pool and found a caveman. Link is a great guy, just keep him away from the food.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Dave's words, but no source has Dave saying it. It is a note in his voice and fits the plot (pool dig, frozen caveman), so it needs no quote marks.
facts.fix: Keep the words, store it as a note with no quote marks.
